title: dowhile router
description: Sends the message along the link with rule dowhile as long as the link's condition holds for it, checked before every round, with header loop.index; then along the other link, if any. As an action the rest of the flow is run once per round.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the condition, when the dowhile link does not set one

expression.title: Condition
expression.description: The condition, when the dowhile link has none

copy.title: Copy
copy.description: Accepted for compatibility; has no effect

maxLoops.title: Maximum rounds
maxLoops.description: The loop ends after this many rounds, even when the condition still holds
